phase_name: Stash identity carries the task number

objectives.description: Change three stash message strings to include TASK_NUM
objectives.note: TASK_NUM's derivation was moved out of Phase 3's guard-only conditional to unconditional scope (right after the clean-tree check) since --no-revert mode also needs it for its own stash message but never enters the guard block. Falls back to 'unknown' via ${TASK_NUM:-unknown} when TASK_DIR's basename has no leading digit run.

objectives.description: Confirm STASH_REF parsing still resolves; confirm no consumer parses the message
objectives.note: Verified in a live fixture: git stash list shows 'git-snapshot-900-<ts>'; STASH_REF is parsed from the ref column (stash@{N}), unaffected. Repo-wide grep for the git-snapshot- prefix outside specs/** shows only git-snapshot.sh itself and guard-destructive-git.sh (which reads only the .git-snapshot-marker filename, never the stash message).
